objective: Preserve original functionality, interactions and data behavior in the Go production program.
implementation_gaps: Unbound legacy pending password/email/MFA/phone/SMS checkpoints cannot continue seamlessly. They remain preserved and require explicit relogin.
intentional_differences: Explicit invalid or expired authorization stops phone operations instead of keeping an unusable manual input loop.
Fresh authentication uses Chromium from its first request. Go owns the protocol state machine and raw redirects. Independent refresh and callback grants use Go TLS.
real_environment_acceptance_remaining: Authorized real account flows and changes
All real Cloudflare/Turnstile branches and authentication endpoint acceptance of Sentinel/SO
